assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints; the official polygon is an organizer-owned external input that has not been released.
assumptions.impact: Current participant action is not possible without that input. The organizer's publication triggers participant full-chain recalculation of geometry, metrics, figures, bilingual HTML, A3/A0 and a difference report; no substitute boundary is presented as official.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, existing buildings, utilities, flood, fire, heritage and facilities are absent.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, demolition, road engineering, utility capacity, budget and construction commitments remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints express possible courtyard and active-edge relationships, not surveyed existing buildings.
assumptions.impact: Retain/retrofit/add actions are priorities for later study, not property decisions.

assumptions.statement: Operators and partners are proposed role types, not confirmed organisations.
assumptions.impact: The pre-feasibility handoff defines decision, evidence, handoff and exit responsibilities for eight role types, but every role remains UNASSIGNED until signable evidence exists. This is a future field-launch gate, not an outstanding concept-package repair; no scene opens until named legal entities accept accountability, resources, insurance, stop and restoration duties.

assumptions.statement: S/M/L resource bands indicate relative delivery effort without monetary ranges. The pre-feasibility handoff defines quantity sequencing, CAPEX/OPEX/maintenance/restoration accounts and the inputs required for a professional ROM estimate, but it contains no CNY value.
assumptions.impact: The implementation budget remains unknown. Verified quantities, dated local rates or quotations, operating-hours and staffing assumptions, lifecycle cost, lawful procurement and confirmed funding are required before implementation.

assumptions.statement: X Census measures explicit regex matches in the current git tree; it is not semantic peer review or a quality ranking.
assumptions.impact: Counts are retained even when unfavourable, include per-package rule matches, and must be rerun after repository or rule changes.

assumptions.statement: Railway section, authority, stop, record and switchback principles are design translations from official sources, not direct application of railway operating law.
assumptions.impact: X tickets have no legal effect; railway signals, protected geometry and technical terms require professional heritage and railway review before public installation.

assumptions.statement: The checked-in OSM slice records publicly mapped features at one timestamp and may be incomplete or outdated.
assumptions.impact: Mapped counts and line lengths distinguish rough urban context only; official survey, ownership, traffic, accessibility and engineering evidence must replace them before site decisions.

assumptions.statement: The four text-only Codex concept images generated on 2026-08-24, Asia/Shanghai, were superseded by four distinct current assets generated or transformed through OpenAI image generation in ChatGPT on 2026-08-25, Asia/Shanghai; these are separate asset-version events, not timezone variants of one event. Exact clock times were not retained. For the current assets, service, calendar date and timezone, generation record IDs, participant-provided concept visual references in the conversation, instructions, terms, post-processing and final hashes are recorded; the tool did not surface a specific image-model identifier, so it remains unknown.
assumptions.impact: The images may be used and redistributed under the recorded service terms and disclosure conditions, but no claim is made about copyrightability, uniqueness, non-infringement, factual accuracy, site conditions or approval.
